summary: Cumberland County, TN tower listed standing by Tennessee Landforms and on a 2014 National Register list; no build, design or staffing records found.

facts.status_note: Tennessee Landforms lists it as standing, and a 2014 National Register list of towers standing on March 26, 2014 includes it. No later check of its condition was found.

notes_for_editor: Only two sources. Two searches, the Forest Lookouts Tennessee index (easternuslookouts.weebly.com) and the NHLR Tennessee index (nhlr.org/lookouts/us/tn/) found no build date, designer, staffing or fire record, and neither index lists this Pilot Knob. Do not confuse with the Clay County Pilot Knob (us-tn-pilot-knob), which is also on the 2014 list. The 2014 listing is the latest dated status; no current check. Access and visiting arrangements are unknown. Confidence is medium only for identity, county, elevation and the 2014 listing.
